442.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
442.text: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

451.name: A Recipe For Death
451.text: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

480.name: The Weaver
480.text: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

498.name: The Rescue
498.text: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

501.name: Elixir of Pain
501.text: Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

527.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
527.text: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

567.name: Dangerous!
567.text: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.

846.name: Revenge of Gann
846.text: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.

891.name: The Guns of Northwatch
891.text: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 Theramore Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.

959.name: Trouble at the Docks
959.text: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.

1013.name: The Book of Ur
1013.text: Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

1014.name: Arugal Must Die
1014.text: Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

1069.name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
1069.text: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

1098.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
1098.text: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.

1131.name: Steelsnap
1131.text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

1195.name: The Sacred Flame
1195.text: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

1221.name: Blueleaf Tubers
1221.text: Grab a Crate with Holes. Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick. Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual. In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers. Bring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

1483.name: Ziz Fizziks
1483.text: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag.

1509.name: News of Dogran
1509.text: Speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads.

1740.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
1740.text: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.

5725.name: The Power to Destroy...
5725.text: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

6503.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
6503.text: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.name: The Lost Pages
6504.text: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
6543.text: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6571.name: Warsong Supplies
6571.text: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

8171.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
8171.text: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

8368.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
8368.text: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8370.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
8370.text: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
